<section class="jr-sec jr-chapters" id="chapters" aria-labelledby="h-jr-chapters">
  <div class="jr-head jr-head-row"><h2 id="h-jr-chapters">Chapters</h2><button type="button" class="jr-firsts-btn" aria-pressed="false" hidden><span class="jr-star" aria-hidden="true"></span>Firsts only</button></div>
  <p class="jr-firsts-note" hidden>Showing the firsts and the milestones only.</p>
  <ol class="jr-chapter-list">
    <li class="jr-chapter" id="ch-baotou" style="--ch: var(--ch-baotou)">
      <div class="jr-ch-head">
        <p class="jr-ch-when">Sep 2010 – Jun 2014</p>
        <h3><span class="jr-key" aria-hidden="true"></span>Baotou <span class="jr-ch-where">Inner Mongolia, China</span></h3>
        <p class="jr-ch-line">A B.A. in English at Inner Mongolia University of Science and Technology, farther from home than I had ever been. Four years on the northern edge of the country, and the first journeys of my own, ending in a sixty-day loop around China.</p>
      </div>
      <ol class="jr-entries">
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-leave-home-2010" data-entry="leave-home-2010">
          <span class="jr-when">Sep 2010</span>
          <p class="jr-text">From home in Shouguang to university in Baotou: the farthest I had been. <span class="jr-stamp" style="--ch: var(--ch-baotou); --rot: -4deg">First time away from home</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-ordos-hohhot" data-entry="ordos-hohhot">
          <span class="jr-when">2010–2014</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Ordos and Hohhot: near enough to Baotou to become familiar ground.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-yinchuan-2011" data-entry="yinchuan-2011">
          <span class="jr-when">May 2011</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Yinchuan, over the May Day holiday: a trip for its own sake. <span class="jr-stamp is-round" style="--ch: var(--ch-baotou); --rot: 2.5deg">First trip of my own</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-mt-heng-2012" data-entry="mt-heng-2012">
          <span class="jr-when">May 2012</span>
          <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="On foot"><i class="bi bi-person-walking" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>Datong and Mount Heng, the northern of the Five Great Mountains. <span class="jr-stamp" style="--ch: var(--ch-baotou); --rot: -1.5deg">First of the Five Great Mountains</span><span class="jr-peakchip" title="Tianfeng Peak"><i class="bi bi-triangle-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i>2,016 m</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-qingdao-2012" data-entry="qingdao-2012">
          <span class="jr-when">Summer 2012</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Qingdao, on the Yellow Sea, in the summer holiday. <span class="jr-stamp is-round" style="--ch: var(--ch-baotou); --rot: 3.5deg">First time in Qingdao</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-kubuqi-2012" data-entry="kubuqi-2012">
          <span class="jr-when">Sep 2012</span>
          <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="By bicycle"><i class="bi bi-bicycle" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>By bicycle from Baotou across the Yellow River into the Kubuqi Desert. <span class="jr-stamp is-round" style="--ch: var(--ch-baotou); --rot: -2.5deg">First desert</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first has-stops" id="e-china-loop-2013" data-entry="china-loop-2013">
          <span class="jr-when">Jul–Sep 2013</span>
          <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="By train"><i class="bi bi-train-front" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>Sixty days and 12,162 km around China, through 17 provinces and regions and 33 cities; the Five Great Mountains finished, each climbed and descended on foot. <span class="jr-badge jr-badge-ms">All Five Great Mountains</span></p>
          <ol class="jr-stops" aria-label="Main stops">
            <li class="jr-entry" id="e-loop-xian" data-entry="loop-xian">
              <span class="jr-when"></span>
              <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="On foot"><i class="bi bi-person-walking" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>Xi&#x27;an and Mount Hua, the West: the Qinling, the Terracotta Army, the Big Wild Goose Pagoda and Datang Everbright City. <span class="jr-peakchip" title="South Peak"><i class="bi bi-triangle-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i>2,155 m</span></p>
            </li>
            <li class="jr-entry" id="e-loop-qinghai" data-entry="loop-qinghai">
              <span class="jr-when"></span>
              <p class="jr-text">Qinghai Lake and Riyue Mountain, with the rapeseed in flower.</p>
            </li>
            <li class="jr-entry" id="e-loop-lhasa" data-entry="loop-lhasa">
              <span class="jr-when"></span>
              <p class="jr-text">By train onto the plateau, to Lhasa: the Jokhang Temple and Namtso.</p>
            </li>
            <li class="jr-entry" id="e-loop-yunnan" data-entry="loop-yunnan">
              <span class="jr-when"></span>
              <p class="jr-text">Down into Yunnan: Shangri-La, Lijiang, Dali and Kunming.</p>
            </li>
            <li class="jr-entry" id="e-loop-guizhou-guangxi" data-entry="loop-guizhou-guangxi">
              <span class="jr-when"></span>
              <p class="jr-text">East through Guizhou to the karst of Guilin and Yangshuo.</p>
            </li>
            <li class="jr-entry" id="e-loop-hunan" data-entry="loop-hunan">
              <span class="jr-when"></span>
              <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="On foot"><i class="bi bi-person-walking" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>Into Hunan for Mount Heng, the South, and the old town of Fenghuang; then on through Hubei. <span class="jr-peakchip" title="Zhurong Peak"><i class="bi bi-triangle-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i>1,300 m</span></p>
            </li>
            <li class="jr-entry" id="e-loop-henan" data-entry="loop-henan">
              <span class="jr-when"></span>
              <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="On foot"><i class="bi bi-person-walking" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>Henan: the Shaolin Temple below Mount Song, the Centre, and Kaifeng. <span class="jr-peakchip" title="Junji Peak"><i class="bi bi-triangle-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i>1,492 m</span></p>
            </li>
            <li class="jr-entry" id="e-loop-shandong" data-entry="loop-shandong">
              <span class="jr-when"></span>
              <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="On foot"><i class="bi bi-person-walking" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>Mount Tai, the East: the last of the five. <span class="jr-peakchip" title="Jade Emperor Peak"><i class="bi bi-triangle-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i>1,545 m</span></p>
            </li>
            <li class="jr-entry" id="e-loop-bohai" data-entry="loop-bohai">
              <span class="jr-when"></span>
              <p class="jr-text">Around the Bohai Sea and back through Shanxi to Baotou.</p>
            </li>
          </ol>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-jinan-2014" data-entry="jinan-2014">
          <span class="jr-when">Spring 2014</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Jinan, the capital of my home province. <span class="jr-stamp is-round" style="--ch: var(--ch-baotou); --rot: 1.5deg">First time in Jinan</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-ba-2014" data-entry="ba-2014">
          <span class="jr-when">2014</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Graduated with a B.A. in English. <span class="jr-badge jr-badge-ms">B.A.</span></p>
        </li>
      </ol>
    </li>
    <li class="jr-chapter" id="ch-shanghai-bali" style="--ch: var(--ch-shanghai-bali)">
      <div class="jr-ch-head">
        <p class="jr-ch-when">Jul 2014 – Oct 2015</p>
        <h3><span class="jr-key" aria-hidden="true"></span>Shanghai and Bali <span class="jr-ch-where">China and Indonesia</span></h3>
        <p class="jr-ch-line">A first job in Shanghai, and two months later a first posting abroad: thirteen months on Bali, at a power plant under construction. Away from the site, the island taught me to dive, to fly and to surf.</p>
      </div>
      <ol class="jr-entries">
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-shanghai-2014" data-entry="shanghai-2014">
          <span class="jr-when">Jul 2014</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Shanghai, and the first job. <span class="jr-stamp is-round" style="--ch: var(--ch-shanghai-bali); --rot: -4deg">First job</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-hangzhou-wuzhen-2014" data-entry="hangzhou-wuzhen-2014">
          <span class="jr-when">Summer 2014</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Two summer months around Shanghai, Hangzhou and the water town of Wuzhen among them.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-bali-2014" data-entry="bali-2014">
          <span class="jr-when">Sep 2014</span>
          <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="By plane"><i class="bi bi-airplane" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>To Bali for the first project abroad, by way of a transit in Brunei that never left the airport. <span class="jr-stamp is-round" style="--ch: var(--ch-shanghai-bali); --rot: 2.5deg">First country abroad</span><span class="jr-tag">Brunei: transit, no entry</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-bali-2014-15" data-entry="bali-2014-15">
          <span class="jr-when">Sep 2014 – Oct 2015</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Thirteen months on Bali, at a power plant under construction on the northwest coast; in the time off, nearly every corner of the island.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-bali-firsts" data-entry="bali-firsts">
          <span class="jr-when">Sep 2014 – Oct 2015</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Under the water, in the air and on the waves: diving, with a scuba certification, paragliding and surfing. <span class="jr-stamp is-round" style="--ch: var(--ch-shanghai-bali); --rot: -1.5deg">Learned to dive</span><span class="jr-stamp is-round" style="--ch: var(--ch-shanghai-bali); --rot: 3.5deg">First paragliding flight</span><span class="jr-stamp is-round" style="--ch: var(--ch-shanghai-bali); --rot: -2.5deg">First surf</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-transits-2015" data-entry="transits-2015">
          <span class="jr-when">2014–2015</span>
          <p class="jr-text">A trip home, changing planes in Beijing and Hong Kong. <span class="jr-stamp" style="--ch: var(--ch-shanghai-bali); --rot: 1.5deg">First time in Beijing and Hong Kong</span><span class="jr-tag">Beijing: transit</span><span class="jr-tag">Hong Kong: transit</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-nusa-lembongan-2015" data-entry="nusa-lembongan-2015">
          <span class="jr-when">Aug 2015</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Nusa Lembongan, the small island across the strait.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-bali-loop-2015" data-entry="bali-loop-2015">
          <span class="jr-when">Before Oct 2015</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Before leaving, one full loop around the island.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-hong-kong-2015" data-entry="hong-kong-2015">
          <span class="jr-when">Oct 2015</span>
          <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="By plane"><i class="bi bi-airplane" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>From Bali to Hong Kong for the better part of a week.</p>
        </li>
      </ol>
    </li>
    <li class="jr-chapter" id="ch-between" style="--ch: var(--ch-between)">
      <div class="jr-ch-head">
        <p class="jr-ch-when">Oct 2015 – Sep 2016</p>
        <h3><span class="jr-key" aria-hidden="true"></span>China, between postings <span class="jr-ch-where">Shanghai and home</span></h3>
        <p class="jr-ch-line">A year back in China between two postings abroad, with Shanghai as the base. It was also the start of a long road back to study.</p>
      </div>
      <ol class="jr-entries">
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-home-2015" data-entry="home-2015">
          <span class="jr-when">Oct 2015</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Home to Shouguang to rest, then back to Shanghai.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-huangshan-2015" data-entry="huangshan-2015">
          <span class="jr-when">Nov 2015</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Mount Huang, in Anhui.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-nantong-2015" data-entry="nantong-2015">
          <span class="jr-when">Dec 2015</span>
          <p class="jr-text">A month in Nantong, across the Yangtze from Shanghai.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-dmu-2016" data-entry="dmu-2016">
          <span class="jr-when">Feb 2016</span>
          <p class="jr-text">A part-time master&#x27;s begins, at Dalian Maritime University.</p>
        </li>
      </ol>
    </li>
    <li class="jr-chapter" id="ch-lagos" style="--ch: var(--ch-lagos)">
      <div class="jr-ch-head">
        <p class="jr-ch-when">Sep 2016 – Apr 2019</p>
        <h3><span class="jr-key" aria-hidden="true"></span>Lagos <span class="jr-ch-where">Nigeria</span></h3>
        <p class="jr-ch-line">Two and a half years based in Lagos, working in West Africa. The way home ran through the Gulf and Istanbul, and its stops became places of their own; by the end, a part-time master&#x27;s was complete and the next move was to study in America.</p>
      </div>
      <ol class="jr-entries">
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-lagos-2016" data-entry="lagos-2016">
          <span class="jr-when">Sep 2016</span>
          <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="By plane"><i class="bi bi-airplane" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>To Lagos, and two and a half years of life in Nigeria.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-west-africa" data-entry="west-africa">
          <span class="jr-when">2016–2019</span>
          <p class="jr-text">From Lagos, north into Niger and west to Ghana and Togo.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-doha-2017" data-entry="doha-2017">
          <span class="jr-when">Feb 2017</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Doha, on the long way home. <span class="jr-stamp is-round" style="--ch: var(--ch-lagos); --rot: -4deg">First time in Qatar</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-siguniang-2017" data-entry="siguniang-2017">
          <span class="jr-when">Oct 2017</span>
          <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="On foot"><i class="bi bi-person-walking" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>On home leave: the second peak of Mount Siguniang, then Chengdu and Wuhan. <span class="jr-stamp is-round" style="--ch: var(--ch-lagos); --rot: 2.5deg">First snow peak</span><span class="jr-peakchip" title="second peak"><i class="bi bi-triangle-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i>5,276 m</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-doha-2017b" data-entry="doha-2017b">
          <span class="jr-when">Oct and Nov 2017</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Doha twice more, with time between flights to see the city.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-abuja-2018" data-entry="abuja-2018">
          <span class="jr-when">May 2018</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Abuja, Nigeria&#x27;s capital. <span class="jr-stamp is-round" style="--ch: var(--ch-lagos); --rot: -1.5deg">First time in Abuja</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-beijing-dubai-2018" data-entry="beijing-dubai-2018">
          <span class="jr-when">Jul 2018</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Beijing, at last with time to see it; then Dubai and Abu Dhabi. <span class="jr-stamp" style="--ch: var(--ch-lagos); --rot: 3.5deg">First real visit to Beijing</span><span class="jr-stamp is-round" style="--ch: var(--ch-lagos); --rot: -2.5deg">First time in Dubai</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-istanbul-2018" data-entry="istanbul-2018">
          <span class="jr-when">Dec 2018</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Istanbul, where Europe meets Asia. <span class="jr-stamp is-round" style="--ch: var(--ch-lagos); --rot: 1.5deg">First time in Istanbul</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-dmu-2018" data-entry="dmu-2018">
          <span class="jr-when">Dec 2018</span>
          <p class="jr-text">The part-time master&#x27;s completed: an M.E. in Computer Engineering from Dalian Maritime University. <span class="jr-badge jr-badge-ms">M.E.</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-leave-nigeria-2019" data-entry="leave-nigeria-2019">
          <span class="jr-when">Apr 2019</span>
          <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="By plane"><i class="bi bi-airplane" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>Leaving Nigeria for good, by way of Istanbul once more.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-visa-2019" data-entry="visa-2019">
          <span class="jr-when">May–Jun 2019</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Beijing and Shanghai, for the U.S. visa.</p>
        </li>
      </ol>
    </li>
    <li class="jr-chapter" id="ch-san-marcos" style="--ch: var(--ch-san-marcos)">
      <div class="jr-ch-head">
        <p class="jr-ch-when">Aug 2019 – Jul 2021</p>
        <h3><span class="jr-key" aria-hidden="true"></span>San Marcos <span class="jr-ch-where">Texas, United States</span></h3>
        <p class="jr-ch-line">The first American home, a university town between Austin and San Antonio, and a second master&#x27;s at Texas State University. The pandemic arrived halfway through, and the two years closed with six months in Washington, DC.</p>
      </div>
      <ol class="jr-entries">
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-leave-home-2019" data-entry="leave-home-2019">
          <span class="jr-when">8 August 2019, 8:08 a.m.</span>
          <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="By car"><i class="bi bi-car-front" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>Left home in Shouguang at 8:08 in the morning, by road to Shanghai and on to the United States. <span class="jr-badge jr-badge-ms">Left for the U.S.</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-seoul-2019" data-entry="seoul-2019">
          <span class="jr-when">Aug 2019</span>
          <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="By plane"><i class="bi bi-airplane" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>A day in Seoul between flights.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-sf-2019" data-entry="sf-2019">
          <span class="jr-when">Aug 2019</span>
          <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="By plane"><i class="bi bi-airplane" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>Landing in America: a day in San Francisco. <span class="jr-stamp" style="--ch: var(--ch-san-marcos); --rot: -4deg">First landing in the U.S.</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-san-marcos-2019" data-entry="san-marcos-2019">
          <span class="jr-when">Aug 2019</span>
          <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="By plane and by car"><i class="bi bi-airplane" aria-hidden="true"></i><i class="bi bi-car-front" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>Austin, then a taxi to San Marcos and two years of study.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-midwest-2019" data-entry="midwest-2019">
          <span class="jr-when">Dec 2019</span>
          <p class="jr-text">The first winter in America, in the Upper Midwest: Madison, then the Twin Cities. <span class="jr-stamp" style="--ch: var(--ch-san-marcos); --rot: 2.5deg">First trip to another state</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-pandemic-2020" data-entry="pandemic-2020">
          <span class="jr-when">Early 2020</span>
          <p class="jr-text">The pandemic begins.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-nasa-2020" data-entry="nasa-2020">
          <span class="jr-when">Sep 2020</span>
          <p class="jr-text">NASA in Houston. <span class="jr-stamp is-round" style="--ch: var(--ch-san-marcos); --rot: -1.5deg">First time at NASA</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-dc-2020" data-entry="dc-2020">
          <span class="jr-when">Late 2020 – Jun 2021</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Six months living in Washington, DC.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-ms-defence-2021" data-entry="ms-defence-2021">
          <span class="jr-when">16 July 2021</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Defended my master&#x27;s at Texas State University. <span class="jr-badge jr-badge-ms">M.S. defence</span></p>
        </li>
      </ol>
    </li>
    <li class="jr-chapter" id="ch-dallas" style="--ch: var(--ch-dallas)">
      <div class="jr-ch-head">
        <p class="jr-ch-when">Jul 2021 – Aug 2024</p>
        <h3><span class="jr-key" aria-hidden="true"></span>Dallas <span class="jr-ch-where">Texas, United States</span></h3>
        <p class="jr-ch-line">The Ph.D. years at The University of Texas at Dallas, and the years the map of the United States began to fill in: long drives, first in company and then alone, from the deserts of West Texas to the Rocky Mountains. Conferences led farther, to Boston and to Europe.</p>
      </div>
      <ol class="jr-entries">
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-dallas-2021" data-entry="dallas-2021">
          <span class="jr-when">Jul 2021</span>
          <p class="jr-text">To Dallas, to begin the Ph.D. at The University of Texas at Dallas. <span class="jr-badge jr-badge-ms">Ph.D. begins</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-west-loop-2021" data-entry="west-loop-2021">
          <span class="jr-when">Nov 2021</span>
          <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="By car"><i class="bi bi-car-front" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>A Thanksgiving loop through the desert: Carlsbad, White Sands, Guadalupe Mountains and Big Bend, home by San Antonio. <span class="jr-stamp is-round" style="--ch: var(--ch-dallas); --rot: 3.5deg">First long road trip</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-europe-2022" data-entry="europe-2022">
          <span class="jr-when">May–Jun 2022</span>
          <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="By plane and by train"><i class="bi bi-airplane" aria-hidden="true"></i><i class="bi bi-train-front" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>Europe for a conference, and a long loop from the Netherlands through Cologne, Paris and Flanders, back to Amsterdam.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-boston-2022" data-entry="boston-2022">
          <span class="jr-when">Jul 2022</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Two weeks in Boston. <span class="jr-stamp is-round" style="--ch: var(--ch-dallas); --rot: -2.5deg">First time in Boston</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-thanksgiving-2022" data-entry="thanksgiving-2022">
          <span class="jr-when">Nov 2022</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Thanksgiving again in West Texas and San Antonio, with a stop at Wonder World.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-new-year-2023" data-entry="new-year-2023">
          <span class="jr-when">Jan 2023</span>
          <p class="jr-text">New Year&#x27;s fireworks over Dallas.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-arkansas-2023" data-entry="arkansas-2023">
          <span class="jr-when">May 2023</span>
          <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="By car"><i class="bi bi-car-front" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>Arkansas in May: hiking in Hot Springs National Park and an off-road drive, then Caddo Lake on the way back. <span class="jr-stamp is-round" style="--ch: var(--ch-dallas); --rot: 1.5deg">First U.S. national park</span><span class="jr-stamp is-round" style="--ch: var(--ch-dallas); --rot: -4deg">First off-road drive</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-boston-2023" data-entry="boston-2023">
          <span class="jr-when">Aug 2023</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Boston again, for a conference.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-denver-loop-2023" data-entry="denver-loop-2023">
          <span class="jr-when">Oct 2023</span>
          <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="By car"><i class="bi bi-car-front" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>A loop of the West, driven alone: Kansas on the way north, I-70 to a conference in Denver and the Rockies, Santa Fe on the way home. <span class="jr-stamp is-round" style="--ch: var(--ch-dallas); --rot: 2.5deg">First solo road trip</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-caddo-grasslands-2023" data-entry="caddo-grasslands-2023">
          <span class="jr-when">Nov 2023</span>
          <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="By car"><i class="bi bi-car-front" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>A night of camping alone in the Caddo National Grasslands. <span class="jr-stamp is-round" style="--ch: var(--ch-dallas); --rot: -1.5deg">First solo camping</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-home-2024" data-entry="home-2024">
          <span class="jr-when">Winter 2023–24</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Home for the Spring Festival, the first since leaving for America, and a climb up Yunmen Mountain with my father. <span class="jr-stamp" style="--ch: var(--ch-dallas); --rot: 3.5deg">First Spring Festival home from the U.S.</span></p>
        </li>
      </ol>
    </li>
    <li class="jr-chapter" id="ch-boston" style="--ch: var(--ch-boston)">
      <div class="jr-ch-head">
        <p class="jr-ch-when">Aug 2024 – Jan 2025</p>
        <h3><span class="jr-key" aria-hidden="true"></span>Boston <span class="jr-ch-where">Massachusetts, United States</span></h3>
        <p class="jr-ch-line">A half-year internship in Boston, reached by driving across the South and up the East Coast. Autumn in New England followed, from Walden Pond to the coast of Maine.</p>
      </div>
      <ol class="jr-entries">
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-drive-boston-2024" data-entry="drive-boston-2024">
          <span class="jr-when">Aug 2024</span>
          <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="By car"><i class="bi bi-car-front" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>From Dallas to Boston by car, across the Mississippi and through the Appalachians to Washington, DC and New York. <span class="jr-stamp is-round" style="--ch: var(--ch-boston); --rot: -2.5deg">First time in New York</span><span class="jr-stamp" style="--ch: var(--ch-boston); --rot: 1.5deg">First sight of the Mississippi</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-walden-rockport-2024" data-entry="walden-rockport-2024">
          <span class="jr-when">2024</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Walden Pond, and Rockport on Cape Ann.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-vermont-2024" data-entry="vermont-2024">
          <span class="jr-when">Early Oct 2024</span>
          <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="By car"><i class="bi bi-car-front" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>Camping in Vermont among the autumn leaves.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-aurora-2024" data-entry="aurora-2024">
          <span class="jr-when">Oct 2024</span>
          <p class="jr-text">An aurora over Boston, and meteors in mid-October. <span class="jr-stamp is-round" style="--ch: var(--ch-boston); --rot: -4deg">First aurora</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-rutgers-2024" data-entry="rutgers-2024">
          <span class="jr-when">Late Oct 2024</span>
          <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="By car"><i class="bi bi-car-front" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>By car to Rutgers University in New Jersey, for a conference.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-new-hampshire-2024" data-entry="new-hampshire-2024">
          <span class="jr-when">Nov 2024</span>
          <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="By car"><i class="bi bi-car-front" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>A day in New Hampshire.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-new-year-2025" data-entry="new-year-2025">
          <span class="jr-when">Dec 2024</span>
          <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="By car"><i class="bi bi-car-front" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>The last day of 2024 on the road north to Portland, Maine; the New Year back in Boston.</p>
        </li>
      </ol>
    </li>
    <li class="jr-chapter" id="ch-idaho-falls" style="--ch: var(--ch-idaho-falls)">
      <div class="jr-ch-head">
        <p class="jr-ch-when">Jan 2025 – Dec 2025</p>
        <h3><span class="jr-key" aria-hidden="true"></span>Idaho Falls <span class="jr-ch-where">Idaho, United States</span></h3>
        <p class="jr-ch-line">Across the whole country by car to eastern Idaho, for an internship at Idaho National Laboratory. Yellowstone was a short drive away; the Ph.D. was defended that September, and the year ended with the long drive south.</p>
      </div>
      <ol class="jr-entries">
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-drive-idaho-2025" data-entry="drive-idaho-2025">
          <span class="jr-when">Jan 2025</span>
          <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="By car"><i class="bi bi-car-front" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>Boston to Idaho Falls in January: Niagara Falls, a few days in Chicago, the Great Plains and the Great Salt Lake.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-yellowstone-2025" data-entry="yellowstone-2025">
          <span class="jr-when">May 2025</span>
          <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="By car"><i class="bi bi-car-front" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>Yellowstone, and a week later a night camping nearby. <span class="jr-stamp" style="--ch: var(--ch-idaho-falls); --rot: 2.5deg">First time in Yellowstone</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-inl-2025" data-entry="inl-2025">
          <span class="jr-when">Aug 2025</span>
          <p class="jr-text">The internship at Idaho National Laboratory ends; I stay on in Idaho Falls.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-phd-defence-2025" data-entry="phd-defence-2025">
          <span class="jr-when">10 September 2025</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Defended my Ph.D. <span class="jr-badge jr-badge-ms">Ph.D. defence</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-drive-texas-2025" data-entry="drive-texas-2025">
          <span class="jr-when">Dec 2025</span>
          <p class="jr-text"><span class="jr-by" role="img" aria-label="By car"><i class="bi bi-car-front" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>South to Texas by the eastern route: Arches, Monument Valley and the Forrest Gump road, the New Mexico desert, Santa Fe, then Austin.</p>
        </li>
      </ol>
    </li>
    <li class="jr-chapter" id="ch-austin" style="--ch: var(--ch-austin)">
      <div class="jr-ch-head">
        <p class="jr-ch-when">Dec 2025 – Apr 2026</p>
        <h3><span class="jr-key" aria-hidden="true"></span>Austin <span class="jr-ch-where">Texas, United States</span></h3>
        <p class="jr-ch-line">A winter in Austin after the Ph.D.: commencement in Dallas in December, and in spring an offer from Kansas State University.</p>
      </div>
      <ol class="jr-entries">
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-graduation-2025" data-entry="graduation-2025">
          <span class="jr-when">12 December 2025</span>
          <p class="jr-text">Commencement in Dallas: Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering. <span class="jr-badge jr-badge-ms">Graduation</span></p>
        </li>
        <li class="jr-entry" id="e-austin-2026" data-entry="austin-2026">
          <span class="jr-when">Winter 2025–26</span>
          <p class="jr-text">A winter in Austin, and an offer from Kansas State University.</p>
        </li>
      </ol>
    </li>
    <li class="jr-chapter" id="ch-manhattan" style="--ch: var(--ch-manhattan)">
      <div class="jr-ch-head">
        <p class="jr-ch-when">Apr 2026 – now</p>
        <h3><span class="jr-key" aria-hidden="true"></span>Manhattan <span class="jr-ch-where">Kansas, United States</span></h3>
        <p class="jr-ch-line">A postdoc at Kansas State University, in Manhattan, Kansas, at the edge of the Flint Hills. The log stays open.</p>
      </div>
      <ol class="jr-entries">
        <li class="jr-entry is-first" id="e-manhattan-2026" data-entry="manhattan-2026">
          <span class="jr-when">Apr 2026</span>
          <p class="jr-text">On to Manhattan, Kansas, as a Postdoctoral Fellow at Kansas State University. <span class="jr-badge jr-badge-ms">Postdoc begins</span></p>
        </li>
      </ol>
    </li>
  </ol>
</section>
